content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: on the cap / floor screen, each Save click (323, 370, 418) is followed by a visible error (app:54, app:61, app:68) and then an OK dismissal (336, 383), after which the user edits Notional (348, 395) and clicks Save again, so the validation feedback does not appear to point to a field the user can fix in place.", "fix": "Fix: On the cap / floor screen, make the Save button's validation handling show the error inline beside the invalid field (and focus that field) instead of a blocking message that needs the OK click, so the Notional correction and re-save happen without the dismiss step.", "cited_event_ids": ["323", "324:w356", "app:54", "336", "348", "370", "app:61", "383", "395", "418", "app:68"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The events do not show which field fails validation on Save; the error text and target are not in the windows.", "Field values are masked, so it cannot be confirmed that the Notional edits are what clears or triggers the error.", "The 'OK' click may dismiss a dialog rather than the error itself; the element type of the error is not in the events.", "The 6.9 s per-loop figure and the severity are taken from the insight facts and were not recomputed from the windows.", "Earlier Trade Date errors (12594, 12701) and the Save on the ir swap screen (147) are outside the insight's cap / floor Save loop and were not used for the cause."]}
